items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Earl Fox and -- I mean, Earl Hines and Ed Fox were beginning to feud. And, we had our cliques in the band, too, at that time.

ctx.x: And, these cats start -- they're getting all close and all hell broke loose in that ball room. Say -- I say, "Look it, you listen to me. This is my hometown. I know what happens when you do things like that, you know."

So, anyway, we went on -- we had a great time. And, so, finally, as I said, Earl Fox and -- I mean, Earl Hines and Ed Fox were beginning to feud. And, we had our cliques in the band, too, at that time. We had the different factions in the band.
Who was -- who was some of the guys in that band then, Budd?
